summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper: fetches Bun and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that invokes `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotated string-array obfuscation pattern (`WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())... }`). `setup.mjs` itself uses obfuscator.io-style identifier mangling (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) to hide the platform-mapping, GitHub-download, ZIP-extraction, and runtime-exec logic. The package presents itself as a React repo-config helper, a purpose with no legitimate need for downloading an alternate JavaScript runtime and executing an obfuscated bundled payload under it at install time. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the payload is invoked via a freshly-downloaded runtime rather than by `node`, bypassing Node-based inspection, and executes on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
